finding: The reviewed 6x8 board is a montage of 48 consecutive BlastEm samples. It is not read by ResComp and is not resident in VRAM as a 48-frame animation.

start_overlay_root_cause.explanation: Transparent regions of the sprite exposed the BG_B marker behind it; no source character pixels need reconstruction.

optimization_decision: The 48-frame montage is temporal evidence, but the prior five-cell resource also contained two real duplicate idle cells. Runtime v02 stores only launch, active contact and recoil, reusing the idle definition for anticipation and recovery.
claim_limit: The optimized ROM boot and clean background were observed. Focused attack playback on the final ROM hash still requires recapture.
